purpose_context: A demanding real adopter (the spec-kitty proving ground) surfaced quality-of-life gaps that also fix doc-kitty's own inconsistencies: required type/kind frontmatter forced onto a large corpus, a hardcoded vocabulary that collides with a Mission-canon adopter's forbidden 'Feature' term, a hand-maintained ADR index that drifts, and stale AGENTS.md/README claims. This mission lands those enablers so first-adopter churn drops and doc-kitty dogfoods its own convention.
purpose_tldr: Cut doc-kitty adoption friction and fix doc-honesty drift: optional/overridable frontmatter, a generated ADR index, and depth-tolerant ADR typing.
